concerns.text: Tasks T015 and T030 implement a 'Minimum Detectable Effect Size (MDES)' calculation using a fixed R²=0.10 assumption. This violates spec FR-006 which mandates calculating the 'Upper Bound of Detectable Effect (UBDE)' based solely on 'observed noise' and 'sample size' without external assumptions. The task silently relaxes the statistical requirement by introducing an arbitrary proxy (R²) forbidden by the spec's Assumptions section.

Task T011 instructs the script to 'download WESAD metadata' and 'query OpenNeuro API' to verify task presence. Spec FR-001 explicitly requires downloading the 'entire WESAD dataset' from Zenodo to scan 'local metadata and event files'. Relying on remote API queries for WESAD verification weakens the reproducibility constraint (Constitution Principle I) and contradicts the spec's requirement for local verification of the full dataset.

Task T031 directs the generation of a report at 'data/audit/regression_report.md'. Spec FR-006 mandates that the 'data_audit.md' report must explicitly state feasibility and include the UBDE (or regression results). The task creates a scope mismatch where the primary deliverable defined in the spec (data_audit.md) is not the target of the implementation, risking a dropped acceptance criterion.
